narrative: Net interest income was EUR 80.8M in FY2025, down 6.6%. Interest expense is only EUR 15.1M because most private-banking deposits sit on sight accounts, so asset repricing passes almost straight through to NII. The ALM model estimates a −100 bps parallel shift would reduce 12-month NII by about EUR 6.2M.

signals.title: Net interest income down 6.6% as rates fall
signals.excerpt: Interest income fell from €102.3M to €95.9M; NII from €86.5M to €80.8M while loans grew 13.5% to €1.72Bn.
